manifest.evaluationScope: Only markets opening at or after the declared cutoff; prior data is calibration context only.
manifest.selection: No candidate selection or live promotion. Fixed variants, fixed minute offsets, chronological 60/20/20 report blocks.
manifest.limits: Policy declared before the fixed evaluation cutoff; results are as-of replays on subsequently settled markets. Forecasts within markets are correlated. Proxy assumes opening basis persists, with trailing absolute residual stress; 95th percentile is empirical, not a guaranteed confidence bound. Historical settlement_ts is assumed public availability, not local historical receipt time. BRTI observations require both event and receipt timestamps. Proxy cannot observe the final settlement minute.

coinbaseShadow.limitation: Observed first ticker per receipt second; 1-second as-of sampling with maximum 5-second event age. No BRTI equivalence or order submission. Coinbase variants are newly declared and have no pre-collection history.

coinbaseBookShadow.limitation: Observed first order-book midpoint per receipt second; 1-second as-of sampling with maximum 5-second event age. No BRTI equivalence or order submission. Coinbase variants are newly declared and have no pre-collection history.
